PokedexDescriptions.abomasnow: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
PokedexDescriptions.abra:
EVOLUTION: Kadabra — Lv16.

It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
PokedexDescriptions.absol: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
PokedexDescriptions.aerodactyl: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.
PokedexDescriptions.aggron: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
PokedexDescriptions.alakazam: Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.
PokedexDescriptions.alcremie: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-diglett: Metallic whiskers sense its surroundings and grow strong in mineral-rich volcanic soil.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-dugtrio: Its long golden whiskers act as sensors and are treated as signs of good fortune.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-exeggutor: Abundant tropical sunlight stretched its neck skyward. Its tail head can act independently to protect the towering body.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-geodude: Magnetic stone in its body makes iron sand cling to its surface and crackle with electricity.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-golem: It launches charged boulders from its back with enough force to shake distant ground.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-graveler: It feeds on dravite and fires electrically charged rocks when angered.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-grimer: It stores toxins inside its body, keeping its surroundings unexpectedly clean as it feeds.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-marowak: It honors lost companions through solemn dances, setting both ends of its bone ablaze.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-meowth: Once raised by royalty, it became proud, fickle, and especially fond of glittering treasure.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-muk: Countless toxins swirl through its vivid body while crystals along it act like poisonous fangs.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-ninetales: Revered as a snowy mountain guardian, it guides the lost with glittering ice crystals.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-persian: Its round face and elegant coat are prized, though it can be calculating and cruel.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-raichu: It focuses electricity through its psychic power and glides over the ground while riding its tail like a surfboard.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-raticate: Its discerning palate makes it hoard only the freshest ingredients for its colony.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-rattata: It is active at night and commands a nest's ordinary Rattata while searching for fresh food.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-sandshrew: It adapted to snowy mountains, gaining a steel-hard hide that slides swiftly over ice.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-sandslash: Its icy spines are steel-hard and shed snow in glittering sprays when it moves.
PokedexDescriptions.alolan-vulpix: It exhales air colder than winter snow and lives peacefully on high frozen peaks.
PokedexDescriptions.altaria: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
PokedexDescriptions.amaura:
EVOLUTION: Aurorus — Lv39 + night.

This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
PokedexDescriptions.ampharos: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
PokedexDescriptions.annihilape: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.
PokedexDescriptions.anorith:
EVOLUTION: Armaldo — Lv40.

It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
PokedexDescriptions.appletun: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
PokedexDescriptions.applin:
EVOLUTION: Flapple — Lv30 + at Ginger West / Tart Apple; Appletun — Lv30 + at Farm / Sweet Apple; Dipplin — Lv30 + at Forest / Syrupy Apple.

It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
PokedexDescriptions.araquanid: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
PokedexDescriptions.arbok: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
PokedexDescriptions.arboliva: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.arcanine: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
PokedexDescriptions.arceus: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its thousand arms.
PokedexDescriptions.ariados: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
PokedexDescriptions.armaldo: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through most anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.
PokedexDescriptions.armarouge: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
PokedexDescriptions.aron:
EVOLUTION: Lairon — Lv32.

It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
PokedexDescriptions.articuno: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
PokedexDescriptions.audino: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
PokedexDescriptions.aurorus: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
PokedexDescriptions.azumarill: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.
PokedexDescriptions.azurill: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
PokedexDescriptions.bagon:
EVOLUTION: Shelgon — Lv30.

Its well-developed neck muscles and iron-like head can smash boulders into pieces.
PokedexDescriptions.banette: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
PokedexDescriptions.barboach: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
PokedexDescriptions.bastiodon: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
PokedexDescriptions.bayleef:
EVOLUTION: Meganium — Lv32.

A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.
PokedexDescriptions.beautifly: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.beedrill: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
PokedexDescriptions.beldum:
EVOLUTION: Metang — Lv20.

The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.
PokedexDescriptions.bellibolt: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
PokedexDescriptions.bellossom: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
PokedexDescriptions.bellsprout:
EVOLUTION: Weepinbell — Lv21.

Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
PokedexDescriptions.bewear: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
PokedexDescriptions.bibarel: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
PokedexDescriptions.bidoof:
EVOLUTION: Bibarel — Lv15.

With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
PokedexDescriptions.bisharp: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
PokedexDescriptions.blacephalon: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
PokedexDescriptions.blastoise: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
PokedexDescriptions.blaziken: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
PokedexDescriptions.blissey: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
PokedexDescriptions.boltund: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
PokedexDescriptions.bonsly:
EVOLUTION: Sudowoodo — knows Mimic.

It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
PokedexDescriptions.bounsweet:
EVOLUTION: Steenee — Lv18.

A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
PokedexDescriptions.braixen:
EVOLUTION: Delphox — Lv36.

It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
PokedexDescriptions.breloom: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
PokedexDescriptions.brionne:
EVOLUTION: Primarina — Lv34.

A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.bronzong: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
PokedexDescriptions.bronzor: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.
PokedexDescriptions.budew:
EVOLUTION: Roselia — Bond80 + day.

When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
PokedexDescriptions.buizel: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
PokedexDescriptions.bulbasaur:
EVOLUTION: Ivysaur — Lv16.

A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.buneary:
EVOLUTION: Lopunny — Bond80.

Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
PokedexDescriptions.butterfree: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
PokedexDescriptions.buzzwole: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
PokedexDescriptions.calyrex: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
PokedexDescriptions.camerupt: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
PokedexDescriptions.capsakid:
EVOLUTION: Scovillain — Lv30 / Fire Stone.

The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
PokedexDescriptions.carbink: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
PokedexDescriptions.cascoon:
EVOLUTION: Dustox — Lv10.

Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
PokedexDescriptions.castform: This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.
PokedexDescriptions.caterpie:
EVOLUTION: Metapod — Lv7.

For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.celebi: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
PokedexDescriptions.celesteela: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
PokedexDescriptions.ceruledge: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
PokedexDescriptions.chandelure: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
PokedexDescriptions.chansey:
EVOLUTION: Blissey — Bond120.

It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
PokedexDescriptions.charcadet:
EVOLUTION: Armarouge — Lv30 + day / Auspicious Armor; Ceruledge — Lv30 + night / Malicious Armor.

Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
PokedexDescriptions.charizard: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
PokedexDescriptions.charjabug:
EVOLUTION: Vikavolt — Lv36 at Mountain, Mines, or Railroad.

Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
PokedexDescriptions.charmander:
EVOLUTION: Charmeleon — Lv16.

The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
PokedexDescriptions.charmeleon:
EVOLUTION: Charizard — Lv36.

It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
PokedexDescriptions.cherrim: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
PokedexDescriptions.cherubi:
EVOLUTION: Cherrim — Lv25.

Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
PokedexDescriptions.chesnaught: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
PokedexDescriptions.chespin:
EVOLUTION: Quilladin — Lv16.

The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
PokedexDescriptions.chikorita:
EVOLUTION: Bayleef — Lv16.

A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.
PokedexDescriptions.chimchar:
EVOLUTION: Monferno — Lv14.

Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
PokedexDescriptions.chinchou:
EVOLUTION: Lanturn — Lv27.

On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
PokedexDescriptions.cinccino: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
PokedexDescriptions.cinderace: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
PokedexDescriptions.clauncher:
EVOLUTION: Clawitzer — Lv37.

They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
PokedexDescriptions.clawitzer: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
PokedexDescriptions.clefable: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.
PokedexDescriptions.clefairy:
EVOLUTION: Clefable — Lv20 / Moon Stone.

It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
PokedexDescriptions.cleffa:
EVOLUTION: Clefairy — Bond80.

Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
PokedexDescriptions.clobbopus:
EVOLUTION: Grapploct — knows Taunt.

It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
PokedexDescriptions.clodsire: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. When attacked, it pushes poisonous spines from its back to defend itself.
PokedexDescriptions.cloyster: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.
PokedexDescriptions.cofagrigus: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
PokedexDescriptions.combee:
EVOLUTION: Vespiquen — Lv21 + Female.

The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
PokedexDescriptions.combusken:
EVOLUTION: Blaziken — Lv36.

Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
PokedexDescriptions.corviknight: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
PokedexDescriptions.corvisquire: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.cosmoem: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
PokedexDescriptions.cosmog: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
PokedexDescriptions.cradily: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
PokedexDescriptions.cramorant: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.
PokedexDescriptions.cranidos:
EVOLUTION: Rampardos — Lv30.

It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.
PokedexDescriptions.cresselia: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams.
PokedexDescriptions.croagunk: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
PokedexDescriptions.crobat: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
PokedexDescriptions.crocalor:
EVOLUTION: Skeledirge — Lv36.

The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
PokedexDescriptions.croconaw:
EVOLUTION: Feraligatr — Lv30.

If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.cubone:
EVOLUTION: Marowak — Lv28.

It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
PokedexDescriptions.cutiefly: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
PokedexDescriptions.cyclizar: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
PokedexDescriptions.cyndaquil:
EVOLUTION: Quilava — Lv14.

It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
PokedexDescriptions.dachsbun: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
PokedexDescriptions.darkrai: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
PokedexDescriptions.dartrix:
EVOLUTIONS: Hisuian Decidueye — Lv34 at Mountain/Mines/Railroad; Decidueye — Lv34 elsewhere.

A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
PokedexDescriptions.decidueye: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
PokedexDescriptions.dedenne: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
PokedexDescriptions.deerling:
EVOLUTION: Sawsbuck — Lv34.

Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
PokedexDescriptions.deino:
EVOLUTION: Zweilous — Lv50.

They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
PokedexDescriptions.delcatty: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
PokedexDescriptions.delphox: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
PokedexDescriptions.deoxys: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.dewgong: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.
PokedexDescriptions.dewott:
EVOLUTIONS: Hisuian Samurott — Lv36 at Mountain/Mines/Railroad; Samurott — Lv36 elsewhere.

Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
PokedexDescriptions.dewpider:
EVOLUTION: Araquanid — Lv22.

It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
PokedexDescriptions.dhelmise: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
PokedexDescriptions.dialga: A legendary Pokémon said to control time. It appears in ancient legends as a deity of the Sinnoh region.
PokedexDescriptions.diglett:
EVOLUTION: Dugtrio — Lv26.

Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
PokedexDescriptions.dipplin:
EVOLUTION: Hydrapple — knows Dragon Cheer.

Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
PokedexDescriptions.ditto: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
PokedexDescriptions.dodrio: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.
PokedexDescriptions.doduo:
EVOLUTION: Dodrio — Lv31.

A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
PokedexDescriptions.dolliv:
EVOLUTION: Arboliva — Lv35.

Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
PokedexDescriptions.donphan: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its Tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.
PokedexDescriptions.dragalge: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
PokedexDescriptions.dragapult: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
PokedexDescriptions.dragonair:
EVOLUTION: Dragonite — Lv55.

Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.
PokedexDescriptions.dragonite: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.
PokedexDescriptions.drakloak:
EVOLUTION: Dragapult — Lv60.

It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
PokedexDescriptions.drampa: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
PokedexDescriptions.drapion: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
PokedexDescriptions.dratini:
EVOLUTION: Dragonair — Lv30.

It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
PokedexDescriptions.dreepy:
EVOLUTION: Drakloak — Lv50.

After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
PokedexDescriptions.drilbur:
EVOLUTION: Excadrill — Lv31.

It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
PokedexDescriptions.drizzile:
EVOLUTION: Inteleon — Lv35.

A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
PokedexDescriptions.drowzee:
EVOLUTION: Hypno — Lv26.

Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.
PokedexDescriptions.druddigon: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
PokedexDescriptions.dubwool: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
PokedexDescriptions.ducklett:
EVOLUTION: Swanna — Lv35.

When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
PokedexDescriptions.dugtrio: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
PokedexDescriptions.duosion:
EVOLUTION: Reuniclus — Lv41.

Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
PokedexDescriptions.durant: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
PokedexDescriptions.dusclops: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
PokedexDescriptions.dusknoir: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
PokedexDescriptions.duskull: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
PokedexDescriptions.dustox: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
PokedexDescriptions.eelektrik: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
PokedexDescriptions.eelektross: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
PokedexDescriptions.eevee: EVOLUTION: Vaporeon — Lv20 + at Beach / Water Stone; Jolteon — Lv20 + at Railroad / Thunder Stone; Flareon — Lv20 + at Desert / Fire Stone; Sylveon — Bond120 + Fairy Move equipped; Espeon — Bond120 + day; Umbreon — Bond120 + night; Leafeon — Lv20 + at Forest / Leaf Stone; Glaceon — Lv20 + at Mountain / Ice Stone.
PokedexDescriptions.eiscue: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
PokedexDescriptions.ekans:
EVOLUTION: Arbok — Lv22.

The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
PokedexDescriptions.eldegoss: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
PokedexDescriptions.electabuzz:
EVOLUTION: Electivire — Lv42 / Electirizer.

Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish blue.
PokedexDescriptions.electivire: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
PokedexDescriptions.electrode: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”
PokedexDescriptions.elekid:
EVOLUTION: Electabuzz — Lv30.

It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.
PokedexDescriptions.emboar: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
PokedexDescriptions.empoleon: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
PokedexDescriptions.entei: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
PokedexDescriptions.espeon: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.
PokedexDescriptions.espurr: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
PokedexDescriptions.excadrill: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
PokedexDescriptions.exeggcute:
EVOLUTION: Exeggutor — (Lv20 / Leaf Stone) outside Beach/Ginger; Alolan Exeggutor — (Lv20 / Leaf Stone) @ Beach/Ginger.

Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
PokedexDescriptions.exeggutor: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
PokedexDescriptions.exploud: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
PokedexDescriptions.farfetchd: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.
PokedexDescriptions.farigiraf: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.
PokedexDescriptions.fearow: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
PokedexDescriptions.feebas:
EVOLUTION: Milotic — Lv30 + Bond80 / Prism Scale.

It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.
PokedexDescriptions.fennekin:
EVOLUTION: Braixen — Lv16.

Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
PokedexDescriptions.feraligatr: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
PokedexDescriptions.fidough:
EVOLUTION: Dachsbun — Lv26.

This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
PokedexDescriptions.flaaffy:
EVOLUTION: Ampharos — Lv30.

Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
PokedexDescriptions.flabebe:
EVOLUTION: Floette — Lv19.

It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
PokedexDescriptions.flapple: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
PokedexDescriptions.flareon: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.
PokedexDescriptions.fletchinder:
EVOLUTION: Talonflame — Lv35.

From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
PokedexDescriptions.fletchling:
EVOLUTION: Fletchinder — Lv17.

These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
PokedexDescriptions.floatzel: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
PokedexDescriptions.floette:
EVOLUTION: Florges — Lv32 / Shiny Stone.

It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
PokedexDescriptions.floragato:
EVOLUTION: Meowscarada — Lv36.

Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
PokedexDescriptions.florges: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
PokedexDescriptions.flutter-mane: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
PokedexDescriptions.flygon: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.
PokedexDescriptions.fomantis:
EVOLUTION: Lurantis — Lv34 during the day.

During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
PokedexDescriptions.froakie:
EVOLUTION: Frogadier — Lv16.

It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
PokedexDescriptions.frogadier:
EVOLUTION: Greninja — Lv36.

It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
PokedexDescriptions.froslass: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
PokedexDescriptions.frosmoth: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
PokedexDescriptions.fuecoco:
EVOLUTION: Crocalor — Lv16.

It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
PokedexDescriptions.furfrou: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
PokedexDescriptions.furret: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
PokedexDescriptions.gabite:
EVOLUTION: Garchomp — Lv48.

It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-articuno: Its psychic power freezes a target's movement as surely as bitter winter air.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-moltres: An evil aura burns like flame around it, exhausting the spirit of anyone it touches.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-ponyta: Life in an ancient forest filled it with psychic energy that shimmers through its mane.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-rapidash: It reads wicked intent and strikes with psychic power focused through its horn.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-slowbro: A Shellder clamped onto its arm, turning their combined toxins into a powerful launcher.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-slowking: A Shellder's bite awakened strange intellect and lets it mix uncanny poisonous brews.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-slowpoke: A diet of spicy seeds changed the particles stored in its body and sharpened its reactions.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-weezing: It consumes polluted air and releases purified gases from the tall crowns on its heads.
PokedexDescriptions.galarian-zapdos: Its mighty legs carry it across mountains at incredible speed before it strikes with crushing kicks.
PokedexDescriptions.gallade: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
PokedexDescriptions.galvantula: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
PokedexDescriptions.garbodor: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.garchomp: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
PokedexDescriptions.gardevoir: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
PokedexDescriptions.garganacl: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
PokedexDescriptions.gastly:
EVOLUTION: Haunter — Lv25.

Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.
PokedexDescriptions.gastrodon: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
PokedexDescriptions.gengar: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
PokedexDescriptions.geodude:
EVOLUTION: Graveler — Lv25.

Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
PokedexDescriptions.gible:
EVOLUTION: Gabite — Lv24.

It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
PokedexDescriptions.girafarig:
EVOLUTION: Farigiraf — knows Twin Beam.

While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn’t need to sleep.
PokedexDescriptions.giratina: A legendary Pokémon banished for its violence. It watches silently from a world on the reverse side of ours.
PokedexDescriptions.glaceon: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
PokedexDescriptions.glalie: To protect itself, it clad its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.
PokedexDescriptions.glameow:
EVOLUTION: Purugly — Lv38.

It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
PokedexDescriptions.gloom:
EVOLUTION: Vileplume — Lv32 / Leaf Stone; Bellossom — Lv32 + day / Sun Stone.

Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
PokedexDescriptions.gogoat: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
PokedexDescriptions.golbat:
EVOLUTION: Crobat — Bond120.

Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
PokedexDescriptions.goldeen:
EVOLUTION: Seaking — Lv33.

It swims at a steady 5 knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.
PokedexDescriptions.golduck: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.
PokedexDescriptions.golem: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.
PokedexDescriptions.golett:
EVOLUTION: Golurk — Lv43.

The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
PokedexDescriptions.golisopod: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
PokedexDescriptions.golurk: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
PokedexDescriptions.goodra: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
PokedexDescriptions.goomy:
EVOLUTION: Sliggoo — Lv40.

The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
PokedexDescriptions.gossifleur:
EVOLUTION: Eldegoss — Lv20.

It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
PokedexDescriptions.gothita:
EVOLUTION: Gothorita — Lv32.

Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
PokedexDescriptions.gothitelle: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
PokedexDescriptions.gothorita:
EVOLUTION: Gothitelle — Lv41.

Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
PokedexDescriptions.gourgeist: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
PokedexDescriptions.grapploct: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
PokedexDescriptions.graveler:
EVOLUTION: Golem — Lv32 / Trade.

With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
PokedexDescriptions.great-tusk: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
PokedexDescriptions.greavard:
EVOLUTION: Houndstone — Lv30 + night.

It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.greninja: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
PokedexDescriptions.grimer:
EVOLUTION: Muk — Lv38.

Sludge exposed to X-rays from the moon transformed into Grimer. It loves feeding on filthy things.
PokedexDescriptions.grimmsnarl: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
PokedexDescriptions.grookey:
EVOLUTION: Thwackey — Lv16.

When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
PokedexDescriptions.grotle:
EVOLUTION: Torterra — Lv32.

It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
PokedexDescriptions.groudon: This legendary Pokémon is said to have expanded the landmass. Its fierce heat evaporates every trace of rain.
PokedexDescriptions.grovyle:
EVOLUTION: Sceptile — Lv36.

Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
PokedexDescriptions.growlithe:
EVOLUTION: Arcanine — Lv20 / Fire Stone.

Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
PokedexDescriptions.grubbin:
EVOLUTION: Charjabug — Lv20.

Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
PokedexDescriptions.guzzlord: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
PokedexDescriptions.gyarados: In ancient literature, there is a record of a Gyarados that razed a village when violence flared.
PokedexDescriptions.hakamo-o:
EVOLUTION: Kommo-o — Lv45.

It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
PokedexDescriptions.happiny:
EVOLUTION: Chansey — Bond80 + day / Oval Stone + day.

It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.
PokedexDescriptions.hatenna:
EVOLUTION: Hattrem — Lv32.

Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
PokedexDescriptions.hatterene: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
PokedexDescriptions.hattrem:
EVOLUTION: Hatterene — Lv42.

No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
PokedexDescriptions.haunter:
EVOLUTION: Gengar — Lv32 / Trade.

If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.
PokedexDescriptions.heatmor: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
PokedexDescriptions.heracross: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.
PokedexDescriptions.herdier:
EVOLUTION: Stoutland — Lv32.

This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.hisuian-decidueye: Its sturdy legs endure Hisui's bitter cold, and its powerful kicks can split trees and shatter stone.
PokedexDescriptions.hisuian-samurott: A cold and relentless fighter, it defeats opponents with deceptive movements and swift shell-blade strikes.
PokedexDescriptions.hisuian-sneasel:
EVOLUTION: Sneasler — Lv30 + day.

Its sturdy claws and poison adapted to harsh highlands, where it scales steep cliffs with ease.
PokedexDescriptions.hisuian-typhlosion: Its ghostly flames are said to purify lost spirits before guiding them onward with a gentle warmth.
PokedexDescriptions.hisuian-zoroark: Its bitter illusions are so powerful that they can physically harm foes, though it protects companions it trusts.
PokedexDescriptions.hisuian-zorua: A departed Zorua was reborn in Hisui after its spiteful spirit gathered power. It disguises itself to terrify its foes.
PokedexDescriptions.hitmonchan: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
PokedexDescriptions.hitmonlee: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
PokedexDescriptions.hitmontop: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.
PokedexDescriptions.ho-oh: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.
PokedexDescriptions.honchkrow: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
PokedexDescriptions.hoothoot:
EVOLUTION: Noctowl — Lv20.

It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.
PokedexDescriptions.hoppip:
EVOLUTION: Skiploom — Lv18.

Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
PokedexDescriptions.horsea:
EVOLUTION: Seadra — Lv32.

Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
PokedexDescriptions.houndoom: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.
PokedexDescriptions.houndour:
EVOLUTION: Houndoom — Lv24.

Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.
PokedexDescriptions.houndstone: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
PokedexDescriptions.hydrapple: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
PokedexDescriptions.hydreigon: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
PokedexDescriptions.hypno: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.
PokedexDescriptions.impidimp:
EVOLUTION: Morgrem — Lv32.

Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
PokedexDescriptions.incineroar: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.
PokedexDescriptions.infernape: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
PokedexDescriptions.inkay:
EVOLUTION: Malamar — Lv30.

Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
PokedexDescriptions.inteleon: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
PokedexDescriptions.iron-bundle: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.
PokedexDescriptions.iron-hands: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.
PokedexDescriptions.iron-leaves: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.
PokedexDescriptions.iron-moth: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.
PokedexDescriptions.iron-thorns: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.
PokedexDescriptions.iron-valiant: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.
PokedexDescriptions.ivysaur:
EVOLUTION: Venusaur — Lv32.

There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
PokedexDescriptions.jangmo-o:
EVOLUTION: Hakamo-o — Lv35.

It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
PokedexDescriptions.jigglypuff:
EVOLUTION: Wigglytuff — Lv20 / Moon Stone.

It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
PokedexDescriptions.jirachi: A wish Pokémon said to wake when falling stars gather overhead.
PokedexDescriptions.jolteon: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.
PokedexDescriptions.joltik: Since it can’t generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
PokedexDescriptions.jumpluff: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
PokedexDescriptions.jynx: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
PokedexDescriptions.kabuto:
EVOLUTION: Kabutops — Lv40.

It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
PokedexDescriptions.kabutops: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
PokedexDescriptions.kadabra:
EVOLUTION: Alakazam — Lv32 / Trade.

When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong alpha waves that can ruin precision devices.
PokedexDescriptions.kakuna:
EVOLUTION: Beedrill — Lv10.

Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.
PokedexDescriptions.kangaskhan: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
PokedexDescriptions.kartana: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
PokedexDescriptions.kingambit: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
PokedexDescriptions.kingdra: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
PokedexDescriptions.kingler: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
PokedexDescriptions.kirlia:
EVOLUTION: Gardevoir — Lv30; Gallade — Lv30 + Male / Dawn Stone + Male.

The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
PokedexDescriptions.kleavor: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
PokedexDescriptions.klefki: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
PokedexDescriptions.koffing:
EVOLUTION: Weezing — Lv35.

Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
PokedexDescriptions.kommo-o: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
PokedexDescriptions.krabby:
EVOLUTION: Kingler — Lv28.

If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
PokedexDescriptions.krokorok:
EVOLUTION: Krookodile — Lv40.

They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
PokedexDescriptions.krookodile: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
PokedexDescriptions.kyogre: This legendary Pokémon has slept in the depths of the sea. It is said to have widened the oceans with torrential rains.
PokedexDescriptions.lairon:
EVOLUTION: Aggron — Lv42.

It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
PokedexDescriptions.lampent:
EVOLUTION: Chandelure — Lv50 / Dusk Stone.

The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
PokedexDescriptions.lanturn: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
PokedexDescriptions.lapras: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.
PokedexDescriptions.larvesta:
EVOLUTION: Volcarona — Lv59.

Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
PokedexDescriptions.larvitar:
EVOLUTION: Pupitar — Lv30.

It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.
PokedexDescriptions.latias: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
PokedexDescriptions.latios: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
PokedexDescriptions.leafeon: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
PokedexDescriptions.leavanny: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.ledian: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
PokedexDescriptions.ledyba: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.
PokedexDescriptions.lickilicky: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
PokedexDescriptions.lickitung:
EVOLUTION: Lickilicky — knows Rollout.

Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.
PokedexDescriptions.lileep:
EVOLUTION: Cradily — Lv40.

It disguises its tentacles as flowers to attract and catch prey. It became extinct in ancient times.
PokedexDescriptions.lilligant: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
PokedexDescriptions.lillipup:
EVOLUTION: Herdier — Lv16.

The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
PokedexDescriptions.linoone: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
PokedexDescriptions.litten:
EVOLUTION: Torracat — Lv17.

While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
PokedexDescriptions.litwick:
EVOLUTION: Lampent — Lv41.

While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
PokedexDescriptions.lokix: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
PokedexDescriptions.lombre:
EVOLUTION: Ludicolo — Lv30.

It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water-grass by day and becomes active at night.
PokedexDescriptions.lopunny: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.
PokedexDescriptions.lotad:
EVOLUTION: Lombre — Lv14.

It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
PokedexDescriptions.loudred:
EVOLUTION: Exploud — Lv40.

It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
PokedexDescriptions.lucario: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
PokedexDescriptions.ludicolo: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
PokedexDescriptions.lugia: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
PokedexDescriptions.lunala: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
PokedexDescriptions.lurantis: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
PokedexDescriptions.luxio:
EVOLUTION: Luxray — Lv30.

Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
PokedexDescriptions.luxray: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.
PokedexDescriptions.lycanroc: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
PokedexDescriptions.machamp: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
PokedexDescriptions.machoke:
EVOLUTION: Machamp — Lv32 / Trade.

Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
PokedexDescriptions.machop:
EVOLUTION: Machoke — Lv28.

It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
PokedexDescriptions.magby:
EVOLUTION: Magmar — Lv30.

It’s small, but its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. Embers escape its mouth and nose when it breathes.
PokedexDescriptions.magcargo: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
PokedexDescriptions.magikarp:
EVOLUTION: Gyarados — Lv20.

It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
PokedexDescriptions.magmar:
EVOLUTION: Magmortar — Lv42 / Magmarizer.

Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
PokedexDescriptions.magmortar: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
PokedexDescriptions.magnemite:
EVOLUTION: Magneton — Lv30.

The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.
PokedexDescriptions.magneton:
EVOLUTION: Magnezone — Lv42 + at Mountain / Thunder Stone.

A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
PokedexDescriptions.magnezone: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.
PokedexDescriptions.malamar: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
PokedexDescriptions.mamoswine: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
PokedexDescriptions.manaphy: A sea-born Pokémon that forms a close bond with almost any creature.
PokedexDescriptions.mankey:
EVOLUTION: Primeape — Lv28.

It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.
PokedexDescriptions.maractus: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
PokedexDescriptions.mareanie:
EVOLUTION: Toxapex — Lv38.

It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
PokedexDescriptions.mareep:
EVOLUTION: Flaaffy — Lv15.

Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
PokedexDescriptions.marill: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
PokedexDescriptions.marowak: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
PokedexDescriptions.marshadow: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
PokedexDescriptions.marshtomp:
EVOLUTION: Swampert — Lv36.

Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
PokedexDescriptions.mawile: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
PokedexDescriptions.meganium: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
PokedexDescriptions.meloetta: A melody Pokémon whose songs carry across the winter shore.
PokedexDescriptions.meowscarada: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
PokedexDescriptions.meowstic: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
PokedexDescriptions.meowth:
EVOLUTION: Persian — Lv28.

It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
PokedexDescriptions.metagross: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
PokedexDescriptions.metang:
EVOLUTION: Metagross — Lv45.

It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
PokedexDescriptions.metapod:
EVOLUTION: Butterfree — Lv10.

A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
PokedexDescriptions.mew: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.mewtwo: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.
PokedexDescriptions.mightyena: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
PokedexDescriptions.milcery:
EVOLUTION: Alcremie — Prismatic Shard.

This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
PokedexDescriptions.milotic: Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.
PokedexDescriptions.miltank: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.
PokedexDescriptions.mime-jr:
EVOLUTION: Mr. Mime — knows Mimic.

In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
PokedexDescriptions.mimikyu: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
PokedexDescriptions.minccino:
EVOLUTION: Cinccino — Lv25 / Shiny Stone.

Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
PokedexDescriptions.misdreavus: It gets nourishment from fear that it absorbs into its red orbs. In daytime, it sleeps in darkness.
PokedexDescriptions.mismagius: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
PokedexDescriptions.moltres: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.
PokedexDescriptions.monferno:
EVOLUTION: Infernape — Lv36.

It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
PokedexDescriptions.morgrem:
EVOLUTION: Grimmsnarl — Lv42.

When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
PokedexDescriptions.mr-mime: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.
PokedexDescriptions.mudbray: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
PokedexDescriptions.mudkip:
EVOLUTION: Marshtomp — Lv16.

Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
PokedexDescriptions.mudsdale: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
PokedexDescriptions.muk: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.
PokedexDescriptions.munchlax:
EVOLUTION: Snorlax — Bond100.

It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
PokedexDescriptions.munna:
EVOLUTION: Musharna — Lv28 + Bond80 / Moon Stone.

This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
PokedexDescriptions.murkrow:
EVOLUTION: Honchkrow — Lv30 + night / Dusk Stone.

It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another’s stashes.
PokedexDescriptions.musharna: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.nacli:
EVOLUTION: Naclstack — Lv24.

It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
PokedexDescriptions.naclstack:
EVOLUTION: Garganacl — Lv38.

This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
PokedexDescriptions.naganadel: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
PokedexDescriptions.nidoking: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.
PokedexDescriptions.nidoqueen: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.
PokedexDescriptions.nidoran-f:
EVOLUTION: Nidorina — Lv16.

Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
PokedexDescriptions.nidoran-m:
EVOLUTION: Nidorino — Lv16.

It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
PokedexDescriptions.nidorina:
EVOLUTION: Nidoqueen — Lv32 / Moon Stone.

The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.
PokedexDescriptions.nidorino:
EVOLUTION: Nidoking — Lv32 / Moon Stone.

It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.
PokedexDescriptions.nihilego: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
PokedexDescriptions.ninetales: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
PokedexDescriptions.noctowl: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
PokedexDescriptions.noibat:
EVOLUTION: Noivern — Lv48.

They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
PokedexDescriptions.noivern: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
PokedexDescriptions.numel:
EVOLUTION: Camerupt — Lv33.

Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
PokedexDescriptions.nymble:
EVOLUTION: Lokix — Lv24.

It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
PokedexDescriptions.oddish:
EVOLUTION: Gloom — Lv21.

During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
PokedexDescriptions.omanyte:
EVOLUTION: Omastar — Lv40.

A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.
PokedexDescriptions.omastar: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.
PokedexDescriptions.onix:
EVOLUTION: Steelix — Lv40 / Metal Coat.

Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
PokedexDescriptions.oshawott:
EVOLUTION: Dewott — Lv17.

The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
PokedexDescriptions.paldean-wooper:
EVOLUTION: Clodsire — Lv20.

After losing a struggle for territory, it adapted to life on land. A poisonous film protects its body from drying out.
PokedexDescriptions.palkia: A legendary Pokémon said to control space. It is described in myth as a deity who bends the boundaries of the world.
PokedexDescriptions.palpitoad:
EVOLUTION: Seismitoad — Lv36.

When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
PokedexDescriptions.pancham:
EVOLUTION: Pangoro — Lv32.

It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
PokedexDescriptions.pangoro: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.pansage:
EVOLUTION: Simisage — Lv28 / Leaf Stone.

It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
PokedexDescriptions.paras:
EVOLUTION: Parasect — Lv24.

Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
PokedexDescriptions.parasect: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
PokedexDescriptions.pawniard: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
PokedexDescriptions.pelipper: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
PokedexDescriptions.persian: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
PokedexDescriptions.petilil:
EVOLUTION: Lilligant — Lv28 / Leaf Stone.

The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
PokedexDescriptions.phantump:
EVOLUTION: Trevenant — Lv30 / Trade.

These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
PokedexDescriptions.pheromosa: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
PokedexDescriptions.phione: A drifting sea Pokémon hatched from a gift of the ocean.
PokedexDescriptions.pichu:
EVOLUTION: Pikachu — Bond80.

It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.
PokedexDescriptions.pidgeot: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.
PokedexDescriptions.pidgeotto:
EVOLUTION: Pidgeot — Lv36.

The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.
PokedexDescriptions.pidgey:
EVOLUTION: Pidgeotto — Lv18.

A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
PokedexDescriptions.pignite:
EVOLUTION: Emboar — Lv36.

The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
PokedexDescriptions.pikachu:
EVOLUTION: Raichu — (Lv20 / Thunder Stone) outside Beach/Ginger; Alolan Raichu — (Lv20 / Thunder Stone) @ Beach/Ginger.

It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
PokedexDescriptions.pincurchin: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
PokedexDescriptions.pinsir: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
PokedexDescriptions.piplup:
EVOLUTION: Prinplup — Lv16.

It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
PokedexDescriptions.poipole: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
PokedexDescriptions.politoed: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
PokedexDescriptions.poliwag:
EVOLUTION: Poliwhirl — Lv25.

Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
PokedexDescriptions.poliwhirl:
EVOLUTION: Poliwrath — Lv32 + at Mountain / Water Stone; Politoed — Lv32 + rain + at Forest / King's Rock.

It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.
PokedexDescriptions.poliwrath: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
PokedexDescriptions.polteageist: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
PokedexDescriptions.ponyta:
EVOLUTION: Rapidash — Lv40.

As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
PokedexDescriptions.poochyena:
EVOLUTION: Mightyena — Lv18.

A tenacious Pokémon that chases prey until it becomes exhausted.
PokedexDescriptions.popplio:
EVOLUTION: Brionne — Lv17.

This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
PokedexDescriptions.porygon:
EVOLUTION: Porygon2 — Lv30 / Up-Grade.

A man-made Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.
PokedexDescriptions.porygon-z: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
PokedexDescriptions.porygon2:
EVOLUTION: Porygon Z — Lv40 / Dubious Disc.

Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.
PokedexDescriptions.primarina: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
PokedexDescriptions.primeape:
EVOLUTION: Annihilape — knows Rage Fist.

It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
PokedexDescriptions.prinplup:
EVOLUTION: Empoleon — Lv36.

It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
PokedexDescriptions.psyduck:
EVOLUTION: Golduck — Lv33.

It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
PokedexDescriptions.pumpkaboo:
EVOLUTION: Gourgeist — Lv30 / Trade.

The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
PokedexDescriptions.pupitar:
EVOLUTION: Tyranitar — Lv55.

Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
PokedexDescriptions.purugly: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
PokedexDescriptions.pyukumuku: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.quagsire: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.quaquaval: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
PokedexDescriptions.quaxly:
EVOLUTION: Quaxwell — Lv16.

This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
PokedexDescriptions.quaxwell:
EVOLUTION: Quaquaval — Lv36.

These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
PokedexDescriptions.quilava:
EVOLUTIONS: Hisuian Typhlosion — Lv36 at Mountain/Mines/Railroad; Typhlosion — Lv36 elsewhere.

Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.
PokedexDescriptions.quilladin:
EVOLUTION: Chesnaught — Lv36.

It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
PokedexDescriptions.raboot:
EVOLUTION: Cinderace — Lv35.

Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
PokedexDescriptions.raichu: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
PokedexDescriptions.raikou: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
PokedexDescriptions.ralts:
EVOLUTION: Kirlia — Lv20.

If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
PokedexDescriptions.rampardos: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
PokedexDescriptions.rapidash: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
PokedexDescriptions.raticate: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
PokedexDescriptions.rattata:
EVOLUTION: Raticate — Lv20.

Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.
PokedexDescriptions.rayquaza: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
PokedexDescriptions.regice: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.
PokedexDescriptions.regidrago: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
PokedexDescriptions.regieleki: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
PokedexDescriptions.regigigas: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
PokedexDescriptions.regirock: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
PokedexDescriptions.registeel: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
PokedexDescriptions.relicanth: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.
PokedexDescriptions.reshiram: A white dragon whose flames blaze over the island forge.
PokedexDescriptions.reuniclus: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
PokedexDescriptions.revavroom: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.
PokedexDescriptions.rhydon:
EVOLUTION: Rhyperior — Lv42 / Protector.

Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
PokedexDescriptions.rhyhorn:
EVOLUTION: Rhydon — Lv42.

Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
PokedexDescriptions.rhyperior: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
PokedexDescriptions.ribombee: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
PokedexDescriptions.rillaboom: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
PokedexDescriptions.riolu:
EVOLUTION: Lucario — Bond100 + day.

It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
PokedexDescriptions.roaring-moon: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
PokedexDescriptions.rockruff: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
PokedexDescriptions.rookidee: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
PokedexDescriptions.roselia:
EVOLUTION: Roserade — Lv32 + day / Shiny Stone.

It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.
PokedexDescriptions.roserade: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
PokedexDescriptions.rotom: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
PokedexDescriptions.rowlet:
EVOLUTION: Dartrix — Lv17.

This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
PokedexDescriptions.sableye: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
PokedexDescriptions.salamence: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
