PokedexDescriptions.salandit:
EVOLUTION: Salazzle — Lv33 + Female.

It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
PokedexDescriptions.salazzle: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
PokedexDescriptions.samurott: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
PokedexDescriptions.sandile:
EVOLUTION: Krokorok — Lv29.

It moves along below the sand’s surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
PokedexDescriptions.sandshrew:
EVOLUTION: Sandslash — Lv22.

It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
PokedexDescriptions.sandslash: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.
PokedexDescriptions.sandy-shocks: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
PokedexDescriptions.sawsbuck: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
PokedexDescriptions.scatterbug:
EVOLUTION: Spewpa — Lv9.

When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
PokedexDescriptions.sceptile: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
PokedexDescriptions.scizor: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets ahold of into bits.
PokedexDescriptions.scolipede: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
PokedexDescriptions.scorbunny:
EVOLUTION: Raboot — Lv16.

A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
PokedexDescriptions.scovillain: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
PokedexDescriptions.scrafty: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
PokedexDescriptions.scraggy:
EVOLUTION: Scrafty — Lv39.

Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
PokedexDescriptions.scream-tail: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
PokedexDescriptions.scyther:
EVOLUTION: Scizor — Lv42 + at Railroad / Metal Coat; Kleavor — Lv42 + at Mountain / Black Augurite.

It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
PokedexDescriptions.seadra:
EVOLUTION: Kingdra — Lv40 / Dragon Scale.

Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
PokedexDescriptions.seaking: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.
PokedexDescriptions.sealeo:
EVOLUTION: Walrein — Lv44.

It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
PokedexDescriptions.seel:
EVOLUTION: Dewgong — Lv34.

A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
PokedexDescriptions.seismitoad: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
PokedexDescriptions.sentret:
EVOLUTION: Furret — Lv15.

When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.
PokedexDescriptions.serperior: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
PokedexDescriptions.servine:
EVOLUTION: Serperior — Lv36.

It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
PokedexDescriptions.seviper: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
PokedexDescriptions.sewaddle:
EVOLUTION: Swadloon — Lv20.

This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.shaymin: A shy mythical Pokémon that brings flowers to the places it visits.
PokedexDescriptions.shelgon:
EVOLUTION: Salamence — Lv50.

Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
PokedexDescriptions.shellder:
EVOLUTION: Cloyster — Lv20 / Water Stone.

Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
PokedexDescriptions.shellos:
EVOLUTION: Gastrodon — Lv30.

Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
PokedexDescriptions.shieldon:
EVOLUTION: Bastiodon — Lv30.

It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.
PokedexDescriptions.shinx:
EVOLUTION: Luxio — Lv15.

The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
PokedexDescriptions.shroomish:
EVOLUTION: Breloom — Lv23.

It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
PokedexDescriptions.shuppet:
EVOLUTION: Banette — Lv37.

It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice-- or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.
PokedexDescriptions.sigilyph: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
PokedexDescriptions.silcoon:
EVOLUTION: Beautifly — Lv10.

It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
PokedexDescriptions.simisage: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
PokedexDescriptions.sinistea:
EVOLUTION: Polteageist — Lv32 / Cracked Pot / Chipped Pot.

This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
PokedexDescriptions.skarmory: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.
PokedexDescriptions.skeledirge: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
PokedexDescriptions.skiddo:
EVOLUTION: Gogoat — Lv32.

Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
PokedexDescriptions.skiploom:
EVOLUTION: Jumpluff — Lv27.

The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.
PokedexDescriptions.skitty:
EVOLUTION: Delcatty — Lv28 / Moon Stone.

It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
PokedexDescriptions.skorupi:
EVOLUTION: Drapion — Lv40.

It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
PokedexDescriptions.skrelp:
EVOLUTION: Dragalge — Lv48.

Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
PokedexDescriptions.skuntank: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
PokedexDescriptions.sliggoo:
EVOLUTION: Goodra — Lv50 + rain.

It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
PokedexDescriptions.slither-wing: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
PokedexDescriptions.slowbro: An attached Shellder won’t let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
PokedexDescriptions.slowking: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
PokedexDescriptions.slowpoke:
EVOLUTION: Slowbro — Lv20 + day; Slowking — Lv20 + night / King's Rock.

It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
PokedexDescriptions.slugma:
EVOLUTION: Magcargo — Lv38.

A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.
PokedexDescriptions.smeargle: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
PokedexDescriptions.smoliv:
EVOLUTION: Dolliv — Lv25.

It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
PokedexDescriptions.smoochum:
EVOLUTION: Jynx — Lv30.

Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
PokedexDescriptions.sneasel:
EVOLUTION: Weavile — Lv30 + night / Razor Claw + night.

It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
PokedexDescriptions.sneasler: Its long claws carry a potent poison, and its strength lets it race freely across sheer mountain walls.
PokedexDescriptions.snivy:
EVOLUTION: Servine — Lv17.

Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
PokedexDescriptions.snom:
EVOLUTION: Frosmoth — Bond80 + night.

It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
PokedexDescriptions.snorlax: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
PokedexDescriptions.snorunt:
EVOLUTION: Glalie — Lv42; Froslass — Lv42 + Female / Dawn Stone + Female.

It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
PokedexDescriptions.snover:
EVOLUTION: Abomasnow — Lv40.

During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
PokedexDescriptions.sobble:
EVOLUTION: Drizzile — Lv16.

When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
PokedexDescriptions.solgaleo: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
PokedexDescriptions.solosis:
EVOLUTION: Duosion — Lv32.

Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
PokedexDescriptions.spearow:
EVOLUTION: Fearow — Lv20.

Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.
PokedexDescriptions.spewpa:
EVOLUTION: Vivillon — Lv12.

It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
PokedexDescriptions.spheal:
EVOLUTION: Sealeo — Lv32.

They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
PokedexDescriptions.spidops: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
PokedexDescriptions.spinarak:
EVOLUTION: Ariados — Lv22.

It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
PokedexDescriptions.spinda: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
PokedexDescriptions.spiritomb: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
PokedexDescriptions.sprigatito:
EVOLUTION: Floragato — Lv16.

Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
PokedexDescriptions.squirtle:
EVOLUTION: Wartortle — Lv16.

It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
PokedexDescriptions.stakataka: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
PokedexDescriptions.stantler:
EVOLUTION: Wyrdeer — knows Psyshield Bash.

Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
PokedexDescriptions.staraptor: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.staravia:
EVOLUTION: Staraptor — Lv34.

They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
PokedexDescriptions.starly:
EVOLUTION: Staravia — Lv14.

They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
PokedexDescriptions.starmie: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
PokedexDescriptions.staryu:
EVOLUTION: Starmie — Lv20 / Water Stone.

Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.
PokedexDescriptions.steelix: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
PokedexDescriptions.steenee:
EVOLUTION: Tsareena — knows Stomp.

The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
PokedexDescriptions.stoutland: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
PokedexDescriptions.stufful:
EVOLUTION: Bewear — Lv27.

Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
PokedexDescriptions.stunky:
EVOLUTION: Skuntank — Lv34.

It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
PokedexDescriptions.sudowoodo: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.
PokedexDescriptions.suicune: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
PokedexDescriptions.sunflora: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon’s face become more vivid and lively.
PokedexDescriptions.swablu:
EVOLUTION: Altaria — Lv35.

For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
PokedexDescriptions.swadloon:
EVOLUTION: Leavanny — Lv29.

Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
PokedexDescriptions.swampert: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
PokedexDescriptions.swanna: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
PokedexDescriptions.swellow: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
PokedexDescriptions.swoobat: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
PokedexDescriptions.sylveon: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
PokedexDescriptions.tadbulb:
EVOLUTION: Bellibolt — Lv25 / Thunder Stone.

Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
PokedexDescriptions.taillow:
EVOLUTION: Swellow — Lv22.

It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
PokedexDescriptions.talonflame: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
PokedexDescriptions.tangela:
EVOLUTION: Tangrowth — knows Ancient Power.

Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
PokedexDescriptions.tangrowth: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
PokedexDescriptions.tarountula:
EVOLUTION: Spidops — Lv15.

The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.
PokedexDescriptions.tauros: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.
PokedexDescriptions.teddiursa:
EVOLUTION: Ursaring — Lv30.

If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.
PokedexDescriptions.tentacool:
EVOLUTION: Tentacruel — Lv30.

Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
PokedexDescriptions.tentacruel: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
PokedexDescriptions.tepig:
EVOLUTION: Pignite — Lv17.

It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
PokedexDescriptions.thwackey:
EVOLUTION: Rillaboom — Lv35.

The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
PokedexDescriptions.tinkatink:
EVOLUTION: Tinkatuff — Lv24.

It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
PokedexDescriptions.tinkaton: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.
PokedexDescriptions.tinkatuff:
EVOLUTION: Tinkaton — Lv38.

This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
PokedexDescriptions.togekiss: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
PokedexDescriptions.togepi:
EVOLUTION: Togetic — Bond80.

The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
PokedexDescriptions.togetic:
EVOLUTION: Togekiss — Lv32 + Bond120 / Shiny Stone.

It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
PokedexDescriptions.torchic:
EVOLUTION: Combusken — Lv16.

It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
PokedexDescriptions.torkoal: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.
PokedexDescriptions.torracat:
EVOLUTION: Incineroar — Lv34.

At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
PokedexDescriptions.torterra: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
PokedexDescriptions.totodile:
EVOLUTION: Croconaw — Lv18.

It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
PokedexDescriptions.toxapex: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
PokedexDescriptions.toxel:
EVOLUTION: Toxtricity — Lv30.

It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
PokedexDescriptions.toxicroak: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
PokedexDescriptions.toxtricity: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
PokedexDescriptions.trapinch:
EVOLUTION: Vibrava — Lv35.

It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.
PokedexDescriptions.treecko:
EVOLUTION: Grovyle — Lv16.

It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
PokedexDescriptions.trevenant: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
PokedexDescriptions.tropius: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.
PokedexDescriptions.trubbish:
EVOLUTION: Garbodor — Lv36.

The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
PokedexDescriptions.tsareena: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
PokedexDescriptions.turtwig:
EVOLUTION: Grotle — Lv18.

Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
PokedexDescriptions.tympole:
EVOLUTION: Palpitoad — Lv25.

By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
PokedexDescriptions.tynamo: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
PokedexDescriptions.typhlosion: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
PokedexDescriptions.tyranitar: In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and mountains crumble.
PokedexDescriptions.tyrantrum: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
PokedexDescriptions.tyrogue:
EVOLUTION: Hitmonlee — Lv20 + Attack > Defense; Hitmonchan — Lv20 + Attack < Defense; Hitmontop — Lv20 + Attack = Defense.

It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
PokedexDescriptions.tyrunt:
EVOLUTION: Tyrantrum — Lv39 + day.

This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
PokedexDescriptions.umbreon: The light of the moon changed Eevee’s genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.
PokedexDescriptions.ursaluna: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
PokedexDescriptions.ursaring:
EVOLUTION: Ursaluna — Lv45 + night.

With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
PokedexDescriptions.vaporeon: It prefers beautiful shores. With cells similar to water molecules, it could melt in water.
PokedexDescriptions.varoom:
EVOLUTION: Revavroom — Lv40.

It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
PokedexDescriptions.venipede:
EVOLUTION: Whirlipede — Lv22.

It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
PokedexDescriptions.venomoth: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
PokedexDescriptions.venonat:
EVOLUTION: Venomoth — Lv31.

Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
PokedexDescriptions.venusaur: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.
PokedexDescriptions.vespiquen: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
PokedexDescriptions.vibrava:
EVOLUTION: Flygon — Lv45.

The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
PokedexDescriptions.victini: A small victory Pokémon whose warmth lifts the spirits of its friends.
PokedexDescriptions.victreebel: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
PokedexDescriptions.vikavolt: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.vileplume: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
PokedexDescriptions.vivillon: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
PokedexDescriptions.volcarona: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
PokedexDescriptions.voltorb:
EVOLUTION: Electrode — Lv30.

It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.
PokedexDescriptions.vulpix:
EVOLUTION: Ninetales — Lv20 / Fire Stone.

When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
PokedexDescriptions.walking-wake: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.
PokedexDescriptions.walrein: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
PokedexDescriptions.wartortle:
EVOLUTION: Blastoise — Lv36.

When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
PokedexDescriptions.weavile: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
PokedexDescriptions.weedle:
EVOLUTION: Kakuna — Lv7.

Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.
PokedexDescriptions.weepinbell:
EVOLUTION: Victreebel — Lv32 / Leaf Stone.

The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
PokedexDescriptions.weezing: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
PokedexDescriptions.whirlipede:
EVOLUTION: Scolipede — Lv30.

Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
PokedexDescriptions.whiscash: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.
PokedexDescriptions.whismur:
EVOLUTION: Loudred — Lv20.

It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
PokedexDescriptions.wigglytuff: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.
PokedexDescriptions.wimpod:
EVOLUTION: Golisopod — Lv30.

This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
PokedexDescriptions.wingull:
EVOLUTION: Pelipper — Lv25.

Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars as if it were a glider. It folds its wings to rest.
PokedexDescriptions.woobat:
EVOLUTION: Swoobat — Bond80.

Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
PokedexDescriptions.wooloo:
EVOLUTION: Dubwool — Lv24.

Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
PokedexDescriptions.wooper:
EVOLUTION: Quagsire — Lv20.

This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
PokedexDescriptions.wurmple:
EVOLUTIONS: Silcoon — Lv7; Cascoon — Lv7.

It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
PokedexDescriptions.wyrdeer: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
PokedexDescriptions.xerneas: The life Pokémon is said to share vitality with forests and their inhabitants.
PokedexDescriptions.xurkitree: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
PokedexDescriptions.yamask: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
PokedexDescriptions.yamper: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
PokedexDescriptions.yanma:
EVOLUTION: Yanmega — knows Ancient Power.

Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey--even those behind it.
PokedexDescriptions.yanmega: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
PokedexDescriptions.yveltal: An immense dark-winged Pokémon that rests high above the valley.
PokedexDescriptions.zacian: A swift guardian that races through the mountains with a shining blade.
PokedexDescriptions.zamazenta: A steadfast guardian whose presence shields its companions.
PokedexDescriptions.zangoose: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
PokedexDescriptions.zapdos: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
PokedexDescriptions.zekrom: A black dragon whose thunder shakes the old railroad tracks.
PokedexDescriptions.zeraora: A lightning-fast challenger determined to humble overconfident trainers.
PokedexDescriptions.zigzagoon:
EVOLUTION: Linoone — Lv20.

It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
PokedexDescriptions.zoroark: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
PokedexDescriptions.zorua:
EVOLUTION: Zoroark — Lv30.

It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
PokedexDescriptions.zubat:
EVOLUTION: Golbat — Lv22.

Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
PokedexDescriptions.zweilous:
EVOLUTION: Hydreigon — Lv64.

The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

AbilityDescriptions.all-types: While deployed, grants every type affinity.
AbilityDescriptions.arena-trap-1: While deployed, broken mine rocks have an additional 8% chance to reveal a ladder.
AbilityDescriptions.arena-trap-2: While deployed, broken mine rocks have an additional 12% chance to reveal a ladder.
AbilityDescriptions.arena-trap-3: While deployed, broken mine rocks have an additional 16% chance to reveal a ladder.
AbilityDescriptions.bad-dreams: Night begins at 5 PM, and the farmer can stay awake until 3 AM.
AbilityDescriptions.bad-dreams-aura: While deployed, new wild Pokémon have a 50% chance to begin asleep.
AbilityDescriptions.bait-keeper-1: Each cast has a 15% chance not to consume bait.
AbilityDescriptions.bait-keeper-2: Each cast has a 25% chance not to consume bait.
AbilityDescriptions.berserk: While Drampa is deployed at half health or less, Drampa and its farmer deal 25% more damage.
AbilityDescriptions.bountiful-canopy-1: Fruit-tree harvesting has a 15% chance to yield another fruit.
AbilityDescriptions.bountiful-canopy-2: Fruit-tree harvesting has a 25% chance to yield another fruit.
AbilityDescriptions.busy-pollinator-1: Collecting from a Bee House has a 10% chance to yield another Honey.
AbilityDescriptions.busy-pollinator-2: Collecting from a Bee House has a 15% chance to yield another Honey.
AbilityDescriptions.busy-pollinator-3: Collecting from a Bee House has a 20% chance to yield another Honey.
AbilityDescriptions.cheek-pouch-1: While deployed, food restores 10% more health and energy, except full-refill items.
AbilityDescriptions.cheek-pouch-2: While deployed, food restores 20% more health and energy, except full-refill items.
AbilityDescriptions.chlorophyll: On sunny mornings, watered outdoor crops have a 7% chance to gain an additional growth day.
AbilityDescriptions.chlorophyll-1: On sunny mornings, watered outdoor crops have a 4% chance to gain an additional growth day.
AbilityDescriptions.chlorophyll-2: On sunny mornings, watered outdoor crops have a 7% chance to gain an additional growth day.
AbilityDescriptions.chlorophyll-3: On sunny mornings, watered outdoor crops have a 10% chance to gain an additional growth day.
AbilityDescriptions.comforting-song-1: The first daily pet gives an animal 15 additional mood.
AbilityDescriptions.comforting-song-2: The first daily pet gives an animal 25 additional mood.
AbilityDescriptions.compound-search: Collected forage has a 15% chance to rise one quality tier.
AbilityDescriptions.conversation-piece: The first daily conversation with each villager grants 5 additional friendship.
AbilityDescriptions.copycat: While Marshadow copies the farmer's chore type, it builds momentum for two seconds from normal speed to twice the work and animation speed, 50% faster walking, and half chore cooldown. Combat builds the same momentum only while the farmer is fighting nearby.
AbilityDescriptions.cream-of-the-crop: Manually milking a cow has a 20% chance to yield extra Milk.
AbilityDescriptions.creator-bounty: The first crop, fish, forage item, animal product, and mining drop you collect each day yields one extra item. While deployed, Arceus also grants every Type Affinity.
AbilityDescriptions.cute-charm-1: Gifts which increase friendship grant 15% more friendship.
AbilityDescriptions.cute-charm-2: Gifts which increase friendship grant 25% more friendship.
AbilityDescriptions.damp-1: While deployed, damage from the farmer's own bombs is reduced by 50%.
AbilityDescriptions.damp-2: While deployed, the farmer's own bombs deal no damage or knockback to them.
AbilityDescriptions.dark-aura: While deployed, new wild Pokémon have a 75% chance to begin asleep.
AbilityDescriptions.dauntless-shield: Super-effective attacks deal 40% less damage to party Pokémon.
AbilityDescriptions.defiant: Taking monster damage boosts farmer and partner damage by 20% for six seconds, with a 15-second cooldown.
AbilityDescriptions.delta-stream: While Rayquaza is deployed, hostile Pokémon ranged attacks and boss area attacks deal 50% less damage and occur half as often, and boss danger zones are shown 50% longer. Rayquaza's Flying moves deal 40% more damage.
AbilityDescriptions.desolate-land: Deploying Groudon brings clear skies across every map immediately. They last until another field ability changes the weather.
